::: {#def-prior-predictive-check}
#### Prior predictive check

A **prior predictive check** compares a [test quantity](#def-test-quantity) $T(\vy)$
of the observed data
with the distribution of $T(\vY)$ under the [prior predictive distribution](#def-prior-predictive).
If the observed value would be very unlikely under that distribution,
the prior and the data disagree
[@statrethink2e, Section 4.3.2, pp. 82-83].
:::
